facts.fact: Eswatini's Ministry of Education and Training launched a DHIS2-based EMIS for aggregate and individual data collection in 100 Manzini schools in late 2021 and extended it to all schools the following year.
Eswatini's DHIS2-based EMIS collected individual learner data and was extended to all schools in 2022, with individual records needed under the national PIN system.

facts.fact: Gambia launched a preliminary Tracker-based EMIS in two schools with 5,500 students and 200 teachers in 2022, and SEMIS pilots began in 2023.
Eswatini began a limited SEMIS implementation in 10 schools in Lubombo in March 2024, with 50 more schools due in October 2024.
